Class ModRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.ModRegistry
public final class ModRegistry extends Object
The mod's registered blocks and block entity types, and the NeoForge registration glue behind them. Common code reads the registered values through CommonRegistry.
